$comment: Permission surface for agents the harness runs headlessly (claude -p).
There is no human to approve anything in an unattended run, so the policy
must be declared up front. Before this file existed there was none, and
every tool call was refused -- job 135157-520a could not even run
print('hello') and spent 181s reporting that it was blocked.
This VPS is shared with dev-kemenkes, dev-support and monitoring, so the
allowlist is deliberately narrow and deny wins over allow. Widen it with a
test in ops/harness/tests/, never by reaching for a bypass flag.
Deny rules for files use Edit(path), never Write(path): only Edit rules are matched by the file permission checks, and Edit covers every file-editing tool.
2026-09-19: `git add` and `git commit` were allowed so an agent can record
its own work with its own message. Everything that makes a commit leave
this host stays denied -- push, gh, remote set-url, config -- because the
owner's rule is that work reaches dev only as a pull request they approve
in Telegram (bin/lib/ghflow.py). Committing is local; publishing is not.
